title: Takaful Ins proposes 11pc dividend - Business - observerbd.com

organizations.name: board of directors of takaful islami insurance limited

text: Takaful Ins proposes 11pc dividend Published : Thursday, 5 April, 2018 at 12:00 AM Count : 34 Business Desk The Board of Directors of Takaful Islami Insurance Limited (Takaful Ins) has recommended 11 per cent dividend - 5 per cent cash dividend and 6 per cent stock dividend - for its shareholders for the year that concluded on December 31, 2017. The Takaful Ins' annual general meeting (AGM) will be held at 10:00am on May 13, 2018 at the Institution of Diploma Engineers Bangladesh on VIP Road in the city's Kakril area. The company's record date for the AGM is on April 23, 2018. The company has also reported EPS of Tk 1.90, NAV per share of Tk 17.49 and NOCFPS of Tk 0.59 for the same year as against Tk 1.30, Tk 15.99 and Tk 1.89 respectively for the same period of the previous year.Trading of co shares remainsuspended todayTrading of the following companies' shares will remain suspended on its record date today (April 5, 2018) for entitlement of Rights shares.The companies are Zaheen Spinning Limited, Oimex Electrode Limited and Islamic Finance and Investment Company Limited.Trading of their shares will resume on April 8, 2018 after suspension for record date.Beximco okays acquisition ofNuvista Pharma sharesThe Board of Directors of Beximco Pharmaceuticals Limited (Beximco) has considered and approved the acquisition of 10,013,474 ordinary shares of Tk 10.00 each being 85.22 per cent shareholdings of total capital in Nuvista Pharma Limited (Nuvista Pharma) --formerly Organon Bangladesh Limited -- a leading Pharmaceutical company in Bangladesh, specialising in hormones and steroid drugs, in terms of the decision of the shareholders of the company in its AGM and thus it completed the acquisition. The Government of Bangladesh currently holds 12.92 per cent stake in Nuvista Pharma. SPL to transfer ownership ofland in favour of AAPLThe Board of Directors of Summit Power Limited (SPL) has decided that its management has initiated necessary activities for transfer of ownership of 3.38 acres of land; originally purchased in the name of SPL at Kodda in Gazipur for its future expansion, in favour of its subsidiary, Ace Alliance Power Limited (AAPL), at cost (Book Value) for establishment of a 149 MW (HFO/Gas fired) power project on the said land with acquisition of more conjoining land thereof, if required. Registration and other required formalities for the transfer of the land to the transferee are in the process. Trading of co sharesTrading of the following companies' shares will be allowed only in the Spot Market and Block transactions will also be settled as per Spot settlement cycle with cum benefit from today (April 5) to April 8, 2018. The companies are National Housing Finance and Investment Limited (NHFIL) and Singer Bangladesh Limited (Singer BD).Trading of their shares will remain suspended on record date on April 9, 2018.
